title: The Postcards of the reservoir
author: Rosalind Lockridge
blurb: Lena Brightwater, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
